scenes.text: A skip-counting pattern adds or subtracts the same step at every landing. Check both forward and backward travel.
Count 5 jumps back in 2,000s from 50,000. The answer is 40,000. 50,000 minus 5 times 2,000 equals 40,000.
A route during a reading competition moves 4 jumps of 1,000 backward from 19,000. Where does it finish? Pause the video and think.
A route during a reading competition moves 4 jumps of 1,000 backward from 19,000. Where does it finish? The answer is 15,000. 19,000 minus 4 times 1,000 equals 15,000.
